```{r setup}
#| include: false
knitr::opts_chunk$set(message = FALSE, warning = FALSE)

suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(here)
  library(readr)
  library(dplyr)
  library(stringr)
  library(tidyr)
  library(DT)
  library(crosstalk)
  library(htmltools)
})

# ---- helpers ---------------------------------------------------------------
clean_utf8 <- function(df) {
  df |> mutate(across(where(is.character), ~ iconv(.x, from = "", to = "UTF-8", sub = "")))
}

title_case_label <- function(x) str_to_sentence(str_squish(x))

dt_buttons <- function(filename_stub) {
  list(
    list(
      extend = "collection",
      text = "Download filtered",
      buttons = list(
        list(extend = "csv",   text = "CSV",   filename = filename_stub,
             exportOptions = list(columns = ":visible", modifier = list(search = "applied"))),
        list(extend = "excel", text = "Excel", filename = filename_stub,
             exportOptions = list(columns = ":visible", modifier = list(search = "applied"))),
        list(extend = "copy",  text = "Copy",
             exportOptions = list(columns = ":visible", modifier = list(search = "applied")))
      )
    ),
    list(extend = "colvis", text = "Columns")
  )
}

dt_options <- function(filename_stub, wide_cols = integer(0), page_length = 10) {
  list(
    dom = "Bfrtip",
    buttons = dt_buttons(filename_stub),
    pageLength = page_length,
    lengthMenu = list(c(10, 25, 50, 100, -1), c("10", "25", "50", "100", "All")),
    autoWidth = FALSE,
    scrollX = TRUE,
    deferRender = TRUE,
    searchDelay = 300,
    language = list(search = "Search all columns:", searchPlaceholder = "type to search"),
    columnDefs = list(list(targets = wide_cols, className = "wrap-cell"))
  )
}

github_raw <- "https://github.com/KyleMorrison99/synthesis_item_bank/raw/main/data/"
```

```{r load}
#| include: false
data <- read_csv(here("data", "item_bank_reporting_guideline_compiled.csv"),
                 locale = locale(encoding = "UTF-8"), show_col_types = FALSE) |>
  clean_utf8()

study <- read_csv(here("data", "item_bank_reporting_guideline.csv"),
                  locale = locale(encoding = "UTF-8"), show_col_types = FALSE) |>
  rename_with(str_squish) |>
  clean_utf8()

concept <- read_csv(here("data", "item_bank_reporting_guideline_concepts.csv"),
                    locale = locale(encoding = "UTF-8"), show_col_types = FALSE) |>
  clean_utf8()

# one row per guideline (first publication kept) for joining attributes onto items and concepts
guideline_attrs <- study |>
  transmute(
    study_id,
    guideline_type = title_case_label(recode(str_to_lower(str_squish(guideline_extension)),
                                             origional = "original")),
    methodology = title_case_label(methodology_category),
    discipline = title_case_label(discipline),
    year = as.integer(year)
  ) |>
  distinct(study_id, .keep_all = TRUE)

# ---- headline numbers ------------------------------------------------------
n_guidelines   <- n_distinct(study$study_id)
n_publications <- nrow(study)
n_checklists   <- n_distinct(data$checklist)
items_real     <- data |> filter(!is.na(standardised_section))          # drops "not applicable" placeholder rows
n_items        <- nrow(items_real)
n_items_en     <- sum(str_to_lower(str_squish(items_real$language)) == "english")
n_languages    <- n_distinct(str_to_lower(str_squish(data$language)))
concept_real   <- concept |> filter(!is.na(standardised_reporting_item_elements))
n_concept_inst <- nrow(concept_real)
n_concept_uniq <- concept_real |>
  mutate(s = str_to_sentence(str_squish(standardised_section)),
         e = str_squish(standardised_reporting_item_elements)) |>
  distinct(s, e) |> nrow()
year_min <- min(study$year, na.rm = TRUE)
year_max <- max(study$year, na.rm = TRUE)
last_updated <- format(Sys.Date(), "%d %B %Y")
```

::: callout-note
## How to use this page

- **Guidelines** lists each included publication with its type, methodology and discipline. **Reporting items** holds every item verbatim. **Concepts** holds the standardised reporting concepts extracted from each item.
- Drop-down filters above each table combine with AND logic. The boxes under each column heading filter that column; the search box searches all columns.
- **Download filtered** exports the rows currently matched by your filters and searches. The links under each table give the full CSV files.
- The reporting item and concept tables can be joined on `checklist_item_id`; all three tables can be joined on `study_id`.
:::

## Datasets {#datasets .panel-tabset}

### Guidelines

```{r guidelines-data}
guidelines_display <- study |>
  select(study_id, title, year, journal, DOI) |>
  left_join(guideline_attrs |> select(study_id, guideline_type, methodology, discipline), by = "study_id") |>
  mutate(
    year = as.integer(year),
    doi = str_squish(DOI),
    doi = if_else(is.na(doi) | doi == "", NA_character_,
                  sprintf('<a href="https://doi.org/%s" target="_blank">%s</a>', doi, doi)),
    across(c(guideline_type, methodology, discipline), as.factor)
  ) |>
  select(
    `Guideline ID` = study_id,
    Title = title,
    Year = year,
    Journal = journal,
    DOI = doi,
    Type = guideline_type,
    Methodology = methodology,
    Discipline = discipline
  ) |>
  arrange(Year, `Guideline ID`)

sd_guidelines <- SharedData$new(guidelines_display, group = "guidelines")
```

::: {.filter-panel}
::: {.filter-panel-title}

```{r guidelines-filters}
filter_select("discipline_guidelines", "Discipline", sd_guidelines, ~Discipline, multiple = TRUE)
filter_slider("year_guidelines", "Publication year", sd_guidelines, ~Year, step = 1, round = 0)  # round = 0 prints 1999, not 1,999
```

```{r guidelines-table}
)
```

<div class="table-note">One row per publication. A guideline published in several journals (for example PRISMA 2020) has several rows sharing one guideline ID.</div>

### Reporting items

```{r items-data}
items_display <- items_real |>
  left_join(guideline_attrs, by = "study_id") |>
  mutate(
    language = title_case_label(language),
    standardised_section = title_case_label(standardised_section),
    across(c(study_id, checklist, methodology, discipline, standardised_section, language), as.factor)
  ) |>
  select(
    `Guideline ID` = study_id,
    Checklist = checklist,
    `Item ID` = checklist_item_id,
    `Item no.` = reporting_item_number,
    `Reporting item` = reporting_item,
    Section = standardised_section,
    `Section in guideline` = section,
    Topic = topic,
    Language = language,
    Methodology = methodology,
    Discipline = discipline,
    Year = year
  )

sd_items <- SharedData$new(items_display, key = ~`Item ID`, group = "items")
```

### Concepts

```{r concepts-data}
concept_display <- concept_real |>
  left_join(items_real |> select(checklist_item_id, reporting_item), by = "checklist_item_id") |>
  left_join(guideline_attrs, by = "study_id") |>
  mutate(
    standardised_section = title_case_label(standardised_section),
    across(c(study_id, checklist, methodology, discipline, standardised_section, standardised_subsection), as.factor)
  ) |>
  select(
    `Guideline ID` = study_id,
    Checklist = checklist,
    `Item ID` = checklist_item_id,
    `Reporting item` = reporting_item,
    Concept = standardised_reporting_item_elements,
    Section = standardised_section,
    Subsection = standardised_subsection,
    Methodology = methodology,
    Discipline = discipline,
    Year = year
  )

sd_concepts <- SharedData$new(concept_display, group = "concepts")
```

::: {.filter-panel}
::: {.filter-panel-title}

```{r concepts-filters}
filter_select("guideline_concepts", "Guideline", sd_concepts, ~`Guideline ID`, multiple = TRUE)
filter_select("section_concepts", "Manuscript section", sd_concepts, ~Section, multiple = TRUE)
filter_select("subsection_concepts", "Subsection", sd_concepts, ~Subsection, multiple = TRUE)
filter_select("methodology_concepts", "Methodology", sd_concepts, ~Methodology, multiple = TRUE)
filter_select("discipline_concepts", "Discipline", sd_concepts, ~Discipline, multiple = TRUE)
```

```{r concepts-table}
datatable(
  sd_concepts,

  extensions = "Buttons",

```

<div class="table-note">One row per concept per item. An item that asks for several things has several rows; the same concept recurs across items and guidelines. Concepts are worded generically so they can be compared across methodologies ("Report the methodology used to conduct the evidence synthesis" rather than "Identify the report as a systematic review").</div>

### Summary

```{r summary-tables}
section_levels <- c("Title", "Abstract", "Introduction", "Methodology", "Results", "Discussion", "Other information")

items_by_section <- items_real |>
  filter(str_to_lower(str_squish(language)) == "english") |>
  mutate(section = factor(title_case_label(standardised_section), levels = section_levels)) |>
  count(section, name = "items") |>
  arrange(section)

concepts_by_section <- concept_real |>
  mutate(section = factor(title_case_label(standardised_section), levels = section_levels),
         e = str_squish(standardised_reporting_item_elements)) |>
  group_by(section) |>
  summarise(instances = n(), unique = n_distinct(e), .groups = "drop") |>
  arrange(section)

guideline_sets <- concept_real |>
  filter(str_to_lower(str_squish(study_id)) %in% str_to_lower(items_real$study_id)) |>
  mutate(e = str_squish(standardised_reporting_item_elements)) |>
  distinct(study_id, e)
n_sets <- n_distinct(guideline_sets$study_id)
top_concepts <- guideline_sets |>
  count(e, name = "n_guidelines", sort = TRUE) |>
  mutate(pct = 100 * n_guidelines / n_sets) |>
  slice_head(n = 15)

bar_cell <- function(v, vmax, cls = "", max_px = 120) {
  HTML(sprintf('<span class="bar %s" style="width:%.0fpx"></span>%s', cls, max_px * v / vmax, format(v, big.mark = ",")))
}

html_table <- function(df, headers, cells) {
  tags$table(
    tags$thead(tags$tr(lapply(headers, tags$th))),
    tags$tbody(lapply(seq_len(nrow(df)), function(i) tags$tr(cells(df[i, ]))))
  )
}

div(
  class = "summary-grid",
  div(
    class = "summary-card",
    h3(sprintf("Reporting items by manuscript section (%s English-language items)", format(sum(items_by_section$items), big.mark = ","))),
    html_table(items_by_section, c("Section", "Items"), function(r) list(
      tags$td(as.character(r$section)),
      tags$td(class = "num", bar_cell(r$items, max(items_by_section$items)))
    ))
  ),
  div(
    class = "summary-card",
    h3("Concepts by manuscript section"),
    html_table(concepts_by_section, c("Section", "Instances", "Unique"), function(r) list(
      tags$td(as.character(r$section)),
      tags$td(class = "num", bar_cell(r$instances, max(concepts_by_section$instances))),
      tags$td(class = "num", bar_cell(r$unique, max(concepts_by_section$unique), "teal"))
    ))
  ),
  div(
    class = "summary-card",
    h3(sprintf("Most widely requested concepts (%% of %d guidelines with extracted concepts)", n_sets)),
    html_table(top_concepts, c("Concept", "Guidelines", "%"), function(r) list(
      tags$td(r$e),
      tags$td(class = "num", bar_cell(r$n_guidelines, max(top_concepts$n_guidelines), "orange", max_px = 60)),
      tags$td(class = "num", sprintf("%.0f%%", r$pct))
    ))
  )
)
```

## Citation and reuse

If you use these data, please cite the accompanying paper (reference to be added on publication) and the repository:

> Morrison K, Ivimey-Cook ER, Lagisz M, Mizuno A, Santana MS, Santos ESA, Sánchez-Tójar A, Simpson ZP, Grainger M, Macura B, Nakagawa S. An item bank of reporting items and concepts in evidence synthesis reporting guidelines. GitHub repository: <https://github.com/KyleMorrison99/synthesis_item_bank>.

The data and code are released under the licence in the repository. You are welcome to fork or clone the repository, open an issue to suggest corrections or additional guidelines, and build on the item bank for new reporting guidance.
